readiness: Measured 2D hardware concept; Lead acceptance required before modeling. No mechanism/source/animation changes.

lead_acceptance.stage: Accepted for separately versioned static/rigid-mechanism prototype; not final clearance or finished animation approval
lead_acceptance.visual: Inspected full four-panel hardware PNG and measured handoff.
lead_acceptance.explicit_refinement: HingeY690 accepted for prototype with intact6mm padding, nominal5mm parked wall gap and15mm lifted-bale gap; no further reduction/tolerance waiver or capacity/support shrink.
lead_acceptance.conditions: Actual new hardware, seats/locks, truck/neighbor cargo, mechanism sweep and lower stored/lifted bale/hand approach checked before export. Intentional mating contacts distinguished from clashes. Return concrete conflict if failed.
lead_acceptance.deliverable: Versioned source/GLB, exported engine-local pivot/seat/lock markers, finite1.5s unlock/fold/park and coherent close/lock, full normal-speed review video and QA/preservation receipts. No new person pickup/body or other-item hauling clips.
